name: unit-001 native 412 MB host capacity matrix (research-64 section 1.3, scaled to the host)
hostClass: 412 MB host (stricter than the 512 MB target)
note: Sized for unit-001-herdr: 412 MB RAM plus 1 GB swap, with the existing agent stopped. MemoryMax=224M leaves about 190 MB of physical RAM for the kernel, sshd, systemd and journald; the driver preflight still refuses to run if MemoryMax exceeds MemAvailable minus its reserve. Baseline: 1,000 records, 0 relations, tail 63, MemoryHigh=200M, MemorySwapMax=0. Cells that vary relations, tail, tombstones and mutation use 5,000 records because 10,000 records already peaks near the 224M limit (research-64: 244 MiB cgroup peak). Results are measured on a 412 MB host, which is stricter than the 512 MB target; do not present them as 512 MB numbers. Swap 0 is the pass/fail condition; swap 256M cells show where pressure starts. Repeat final candidates with --repeat 5. Disabled cells name the reason; select one explicitly with --only to run it anyway on a larger host.
